segments.text: Connect the wire feeder.
The wire feeder is used to feed wire in laser welding, and it is not needed in metal cleaning or cutting.
segments.zh: 送丝机用于激光焊接时送丝，在金属清洗或切割时不需要。

segments.text: Place the wire feeder on the left side of the main unit. Lock the four caster wheels.
segments.zh: 把送丝机放在主机的左侧。锁住四个脚轮。

segments.text: Connect to the main unit. Use the wire feeder cable to connect them.
segments.zh: 连接到主机。用送丝机线缆把它们连接起来。

segments.text: The small protrusion on the inner wall faces upwards.
Insert the connector.
Screw the metal part.
Install the drive rolls. This video exemplifies installing one millimeter welding wire on the one millimeter guiding rail.
segments.zh: 安装送丝轮。本视频以在 1 毫米导轨上安装 1 毫米焊丝为例。

segments.text: Open the wire feeder.
Open the wire feeding driver.
Remove the screws.
Install the drive rolls.
Install the screws back. Store the other pair of drive rolls above the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把螺丝装回去。把另一对送丝轮存放在送丝驱动器上方。

segments.text: Install the wire feeding tube.
Close the right tensioner.
Loosen the screw on the right side of the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 松开送丝驱动器右侧的螺丝。

segments.text: Insert the end of the wire feeding tube without a fastener to the wire feeder.
segments.zh: 把送丝管没有卡扣的一端插入送丝机。

segments.text: Lead the nozzle in until its stem presses against the right panel of the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把喷嘴滑进去，直到它的杆部抵住送丝驱动器的右侧面板。

segments.text: Tighten the screw to fix the nozzle.
Open the right tensioner.
Load the welding wire.
Unscrew the cap and remove the sleeve.
Align the hole with the pin.
Ensure that the wire spool is installed in the correct direction.
segments.zh: 确保焊丝盘的安装方向正确。

segments.text: After released, the wire comes out from the bottom of the wire spool to enter the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 放线后，焊丝从焊丝盘的底部出来，进入送丝驱动器。

segments.text: Install the sleeve and the cap back.
Take out the wire end. Do not release the wire or it will unravel.
segments.zh: 取出焊丝末端。不要松开焊丝，否则它会散开。

segments.text: Cut off the bent end of the wire.
Thread the wire into the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把焊丝穿入送丝驱动器。

segments.text: Press the wire slightly to make it pass through.
segments.zh: 轻轻按压焊丝，让它穿过去。

segments.text: Ensure that the wire passes through the drive rolls into the wire feeding tube.
segments.zh: 确保焊丝穿过送丝轮进入送丝管。

segments.text: Close the tensioners.
Rotate the tensioner's knobs to adjust the wire feed tension.
segments.zh: 转动压紧器的旋钮来调节送丝张力。

segments.text: Feed the welding wire.
When delivered, the wire feeding tube is installed with a 0.8 slash 1.0 nozzle at the end with a fastener.
segments.zh: 出厂时，送丝管带卡扣的一端已经装好了 0.8/1.0 的喷嘴。

segments.text: Press and hold the feed button on the wire feeder.
segments.zh: 按住送丝机上的送丝按钮。

segments.text: The wire spool rotates counterclockwise at a constant speed.
segments.zh: 焊丝盘以恒定速度逆时针转动。

segments.text: When the wire extends from the nozzle, stop wire feeding.
segments.zh: 当焊丝从喷嘴伸出来时，停止送丝。

segments.text: If the wire extends too far, press the retract button to return the wire.
segments.zh: 如果焊丝伸出太多，按回抽按钮把焊丝退回去。

segments.text: Close the door of the wire feeder.
Install the wire feeding tube on the welding head.
segments.zh: 把送丝管安装到焊接头上。

segments.text: Open the fastener.
Slide it onto the welding head tip.
segments.zh: 把它滑到焊接头的端部。

segments.text: Ensure that the wire comes out from the groove of the welding nozzle.
segments.zh: 确保焊丝从焊接喷嘴的槽中出来。

segments.text: Close the fastener.
Fine-tune the wire.
Secure the wire feeding tube.
Place back on the welding head cradle.
